name: Garima / गरिमा

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Garima Garg is a poet and translator associated with Panchkula, Haryana. Alongside her Hindi poems, her work includes bringing Pradeep Biswal’s poetry into Punjabi. The Pioneer reported the release of that translation, published by Shalandi Books, at the Toshali Literature Festival in February 2023.

Her two poems in Kabita Live approach language as a means of connection and agency. ‘एहसास’ moves through appeals for humane conversation, care for the earth and relief from sorrow. ‘कलम हथियार लायी हूँ’ gives the pen a sharp edge without losing tenderness: its speaker brings feeling, colour and the fragrance of flowers into the act of writing.
